Lesson 6 · Business route

Prediction that survives new cases

Which dispatch-cost forecast is useful for future jobs?

Fictional case. The observations are generated for teaching, not evidence about a real business. The full data-generating process is in the technical appendix.

What the data show

On the untouched fictional test set, the simple baseline has root-mean-square error 37.05 credits; the frozen selected procedure has 23.56 credits.

What would you decide?

Choose the loss that matches costly mistakes, learn every preparation step within development data, and open the final test only after freezing the procedure. Monitor performance when conditions change.

Pause and explain

Does a better score on one test set guarantee the model will win next year?

Compare your reasoning

No. It estimates performance in this generated setting. A future change in jobs, costs or measurement can reverse the ranking.

What the generator knows

Reveal the known truth after making your judgment

The script controls the cost mechanism and can create a new population for a transport stress test. The final test score is still a finite-sample result, not a universal risk guarantee.

The truth belongs to this invented model. A real organization would still need to test the assumptions and collect its own evidence.
